name: RAHUL MALHOTRA
text: Their Crispy Veg Maharaja is truly a 'Maharaja'! The combination of fresh lettuce and a melting cheese blend is absolutely top-notch. The veggies were also quite crunchy.

name: SNEHA REDDY
text: I ordered online, and the burger was delivered to my doorstep in just 25 minutes—perfect for a midnight craving! The packaging was very premium, and the food was piping hot.

name: AMAN SHARMA
text: The best burger spot in town! The quality is absolutely fantastic, and the prices are pocket-friendly too. The double-patty loaded cheese burger has become my absolute favorite.

name: PRIYA PATEL
text: I tried their Spicy Paneer Delight Burger, and the crunch was next-level! I really loved the Peri-Peri spice twist—it gave off authentic Indian vibes.
